metadata.title: Secure Collaboration External / Federated SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan governing external, guest, and federated collaboration scenarios involving non-institutional identities and systems.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: External and federated collaboration capability enabling interaction with non-institutional participants while preserving institutional trust boundaries, accountability, and lifecycle control.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: External collaboration inherits baseline collaboration governance and trust guarantees from the Secure Collaboration Platform SSPP.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: External collaboration consumes institutional and federated identity assertions governed by Secure Identity SSPPs.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: External collaboration relies on Secure Network boundary enforcement, segmentation, and monitoring.

props.name: external-trust-model
props.remarks: Trust extended to external collaborators is explicit, scoped, non-transitive, and time-bounded.

props.name: identity-assurance
props.remarks: External identities are accepted only through approved federation or guest identity mechanisms with known assurance levels.

props.name: membership-persistence
props.remarks: External participation must expire or be explicitly reviewed to prevent residual access.

props.name: data-exposure
props.remarks: External collaborators may access only explicitly approved collaboration contexts, content, and modalities.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: External collaboration aligns with SP 800-47 guidance for system interconnection, trust boundary definition, and responsibility assignment.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: External collaborators commonly participate from unmanaged environments consistent with telework and BYOD threat models.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Real-time external collaboration inherits the identity and trust risks described in secure voice and multimedia communication systems.

system-implementation.remarks: External collaboration is implemented via scoped participation in collaboration modalities under explicit boundary enforcement and observability.

roles.title: External Collaboration Owner
roles.remarks: Defines scope, purpose, and duration for external collaboration engagements.

roles.title: Collaboration Security Monitoring
roles.remarks: Monitors and responds to misuse or policy violations involving external collaborators.

control-implementation.remarks: Security and privacy controls are inherited from the Secure Collaboration Platform, Secure Identity, and Secure Network SSPPs. This SSPP defines additional constraints specific to external participation.
